newsitem.title: POLAND: Merrill recommends NFI Victoria and NFI Fortuna.
newsitem.headline: Merrill recommends NFI Victoria and NFI Fortuna.

text.p: Merrill Lynch recommended investors to buy Poland's NFI 5 Victoria for growth and NFI 13 Fortuna for value play, it said in its June report.

Merrill still advocated buying the mass privatisation (NFI) units as a relatively low risk means of buying into the programme, but said that pricing anomalies in the individual NFIs could be exploited in the next several months.

It said Victoria was a strong growth fund because it had a well-resourced management and attractive sector exposure, while Fortuna had an aggressive timetable of asset sales which had already begun to release significant value.
